title: Chat settings landed on michael/dev (pushed). One gear panel now holds Whisper,

owner_note.text: Chat settings landed on michael/dev (pushed). One gear panel now holds Whisper, Sending to the LLM ("Send after" presets), Recite read-aloud and Interruption, each slider says what its two ends do. Settings save with the voice session; a new session starts from the defaults; Make default and Reset to default are in the panel. A status line beside the mic shows listening, sending, agent working or speaking. Docs: /framework/ux/Dictate/doc/settings.md. One thing to do: restart Servex once and click Make default to confirm /api/session/defaults saves (tested with a fake server only). Known gap: "agent working" shows only while read-aloud is on.
